sections.text:
devnet: one-command isolated local chain
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
This pull request is merged.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/27

Split out of #25 per review (it was an unrelated devnet commit riding the SSE branch; it touches the mining/liveness state machine and consensus-timestamp validity, so it gets its own review). Based on current `main` (post-#26).

`exfer devnet` brings up an isolated single-node chain — instant blocks, no networking, JSON-RPC + SSE on, spendable coinbase fast. It removes the "first five minutes" wall: there was no regtest/devnet mode, so a fresh node could not solo-mine (mining gates on `SyncState::Live`, which needs a confirmed peer at `ASSUME_VALID_HEIGHT` or a zero-peer bootstrap that default seeds defeat).

## What it does
- `Node.devnet` flag: boots straight to Live, mines from genesis via `process_block`, skips the sync manager / outbound / discovery.
- `mining_loop` clamps the block timestamp into the consensus-valid `[min, max]` window when devnet, so a chain from the hard-coded genesis walks its timestamps forward to the present over a few instant blocks instead of stalling on `MAX_TIMESTAMP_GAP`. Mainnet behavior is unchanged (the non-devnet path still bails on a stale clock; the clamp then equals the previous `now.max(min)`).

## Addressing the review feedback from #25
- **Isolation is real.** The inbound P2P listener spawn now lives INSIDE the `!devnet` guard. `handle_inbound` admits `Message::NewTx` straight to the mempool (independent of the dropped `peer_events_rx`, and with `sync_state=Live` the catch-up drop-gates don't apply), so a bound listener would let a remote peer inject txs into a node advertised as fully isolated. With no listener bound there is no inbound path at all.
- **Coinbase maturity is gated on a dedicated `devnet` feature, not `testnet`.** `devnet = ["testnet"]` pulls in trivial difficulty and additionally lowers `COINBASE_MATURITY` to 1. The test suite runs under `--features testnet` and pins the canonical maturity (360) in the consensus-constant tests; gating the change on `testnet` would (and did) break `test_consensus_constants` / `test_tx_rule9_coinbase_maturity`. Build/run with `cargo run --features devnet --bin exfer -- devnet`.
- **Full test build restored.** Updates the hand-written `Node { .. }` literal in `tests/audit_fix_tests_7.rs` for the new `devnet` field (and the fields stale since v1.5.0), and drops two unused test imports (`HashSet`, `OutPoint`).

`cargo test --features testnet`: full suite green (0 failed, 1304 across all binaries). `cargo build --features devnet --bin exfer` clean.
